units.source_text: 从某种意义上说，或许我真的应该被他看不起，也可以说他的志向比我更高吧。

en.t: In a certain sense, perhaps I really did deserve to be looked down on by him; one might also say that his aspirations were higher than mine.
I do not deny that either.

units.source_text: 然而只是眼高，却没有与之相应的本事也成不了大器。

en.t: But if one merely has lofty expectations without the ability to match them, one cannot become anything great.

units.source_text: 我觉得当下最最要紧的，是让他成为一个普通人。

en.t: I thought the most urgent thing at that moment was to make him into an ordinary human being.

units.source_text: 我发现，无论他怎样满脑子伟人形象，只要他本身不成器，就是毫无意义的。

en.t: I realized that however full his head might be of images of great men, it meant nothing unless he himself became a person of substance.

units.source_text: 使他成为普通人的第一个步骤，就是让他坐在异性身旁，让他受到这里发散出的空气的熏染后，再设法更新他那快要生锈的血液。

en.t: The first step in making him ordinary was to seat him beside a woman, let him be permeated by the atmosphere that radiated from there, and then try to renew the blood in him that was beginning to rust.

units.source_text: 这一尝试渐渐有了成效。

en.t: This attempt gradually began to have an effect.

units.source_text: 起初看似很难融合，但慢慢便融为一体了，

en.t: At first they seemed difficult to blend together, but little by little they became one,

units.source_text: K仿佛一点点地发现了自己身外还有世界。

en.t: and K seemed to discover, bit by bit, that there was a world outside himself.

units.source_text: 有一天，他竟然对我说，不应该那么轻视女人。

en.t: One day, he even told me that women should not be looked down on so lightly.

units.source_text: K以前似乎一直想要从女人那里获得同我谈话时一样多的知识和学问。

en.t: In the past, K seemed to have wanted to gain as much knowledge and learning from women as he did when talking with me.

units.source_text: 没有获得的话，便产生轻蔑之念。

en.t: When he failed to obtain it, he would come to feel contempt.

units.source_text: 以前他不懂得，因性别不同应该采取不同的态度，总是以同样的眼光不加区别地看待男人和女人是不对的。

en.t: Before then, he had not understood that different attitudes should be taken according to sex, and that it was wrong always to look at men and women indiscriminately with the same eyes.

units.source_text: 我对他说，如果只有我们两个男人永远地交谈下去，我们只能平行地向前发展。

en.t: I told him that if the two of us men went on talking forever by ourselves, we could only develop forward in parallel.

units.source_text: 我那时正迷恋着小姐，所以才会说出这样的话吧。

en.t: At that time I was infatuated with the young lady, and that was probably why I said such things.

units.source_text: 但是，我内心的秘密却一句也没有向他吐露。

en.t: But I did not reveal a single word of the secret in my heart to him.
